narrative.overview: A crisp contemporary collection counter: Outfit, cool white surfaces, an indigo action accent, a compact kitchen identity, Cooking illustration, dish photographs and tabular naira prices. Choose a kitchen, add a meal, inspect the basket, place an order and follow its status. Kitchen actions and API evidence remain secondary tasks.
